notes: For any non-negative source-stratum weights summing to one, a convex mixture of two identical 33-66% intervals remains 33-66%. Numeric KSH house/apartment weights are therefore unnecessary to preserve the national external validation band.
P64 does not map source-native EHI houses/apartments onto P21 FAMILY_HOUSE/MULTI_DWELLING or any WBL cell. Cell/archetype allocation remains a separate calibrated-model problem.
KSH_DENOMINATOR_BRIDGE is retired as a numeric-weight requirement for the national EHI validation band only. Semantic coverage and subnational/archetype allocation are not resolved.
